candidates.change_summary: Delete the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll sends no funds.
Replace the withdraw amount with 0 so withdrawAll transfers no ether.
Drop the onlyOwner guard from withdrawAll so any caller can drain the contract.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw(uint) performs no ether transfer.
Replace _value with address(this).balance so withdraw transfers the entire contract balance instead of _value.
Replace transfer with an unchecked send so a failed transfer no longer reverts.
Delete the require in onlyOwner so any caller (including via withdraw) passes the guard.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners pass the guard when calling withdraw.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners may pass the onlyOwner modifier.
Delete the require statement so the onlyOwner modifier imposes no access restriction.
Delete the require on the call result so a failed low-level call no longer reverts sendMoney.
Invert the success check so sendMoney reverts whenever the call succeeds and proceeds when it fails.
Send zero value in the call instead of the _value parameter.
Withdraw only half the contract balance instead of the full balance.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can withdraw the full balance.
Increment depositsCount inside the onlyOwner modifier, so any call passing through it (including withdrawAll) changes the publicly readable depositsCount.
